basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated flat in a charming 3-unit Victorian on a quiet, tree-lined street in the vibrant Mission Dolores neighborhood. Blending modern style with classic San Francisco architecture, this home features an open-concept layout, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. The chef's kitchen boasts quartz countertops, Miele appliances, gas range, wine fridge, and custom backsplash, opening to a spacious living and dining area with a sleek gas fireplace. The private primary suite offers a walk-in closet with custom shelving and a stylish bath with a dual vanity and walk-in shower. A second bedroom is also tucked at the rear for peace and privacy. Renovated to the studs in 2015 with white oak hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and custom closets. Additional features include in-unit laundry, air conditioning, forced air heating, dual-paned windows, and custom window treatments. Located in a prime San Francisco location, with easy access to the Castro, Mission, Hayes Valley, Dolores Park, Whole Foods, and public transit. Garage parking for 1 car, shared patio, and low HOA dues. Walk Score of 99!
